The 5-pair chain with exact W0=floor(1e12^0.53)=2290867 (W0^100<=X0^53<(W0+1)^100) plus covering inequalities b0<=X0, b_{k+1}<=a_k+W0+1, a4+W0>=X0+L is a complete proof: re-ran inputs/artifacts/verify_chain.py -> CERTIFICATE VALID; independently re-verified all 10 primalities (deterministic Miller-Rabin + trial-division completeness since n<(1000005)^2 with 1000003 prime), all gaps <=80, and all covering inequalities. originality.rationale: Nearest prior is Alweiss-Luo (2018) 'Bounded gaps between primes in short intervals': full arXiv HTML body inspected; its Theorem 1.1/Corollary 1.2 is an asymptotic density result (unspecified k,d, sufficiently large x) and does not state, list, or imply the explicit finite certificate (X0=1e12,L=1e7,theta=0.53,C=80 with these 5 pairs). No fused source records this exact parameter tuple or pair chain.
